The agent's response never identifies this critical distinction. Instead, it asks clarifying questions and lists generic possible culprits (bucket policy, KMS key policy, trust policy, SCPs, cross-account bucket policy) without ever stating that the OutputBucketName path uses caller credentials rather than the service role. This misses the core diagnostic insight the user needed. Therefore the response does not meet the expected output criteria.
